{%- comment -%}
  Auto-generated llms.txt. Reads only title / description / tags / url of existing posts,
  so nothing inside _posts/ needs to change.

  To tweak:
  - dev_tags: posts with any of these tags go under "Developer & DevOps Guides".
  - Section size limits: n_dev, n_watch, n_bag, n_other (see the "<" checks in the loop).
  - tool_files / info_files: page paths (as in the repo root) to list as tools / site info.
{%- endcomment -%}

{%- assign dev_tags = "devops,cloud-architecture,api-security,api,serverless,docker,wsl2,wordpress,php,web-security,web-tools,sms-tools,email-verification,development,database,database-design,data-engineering,authentication,fintech-payments,billing-ledgers,iot,embedded-systems,edge-computing,distributed-systems,architecture,containers,skrog,messaging,telecom" | split: "," -%}
{%- assign tool_files = "sms-count.md,verify-email.md,qrcode.md,url-encode.md,html-encode.md,whatsapp.md,tiny.md,embeded-url.md,disc-test.md" | split: "," -%}
{%- assign info_files = "archive.html,tags.md,contact.md,disclaimer.md,partnerships.md" | split: "," -%}

{%- capture nl %}
{% endcapture -%}

{%- assign dev_list = "" -%}
{%- assign watch_list = "" -%}
{%- assign bag_list = "" -%}
{%- assign other_list = "" -%}
{%- assign n_dev = 0 -%}
{%- assign n_watch = 0 -%}
{%- assign n_bag = 0 -%}
{%- assign n_other = 0 -%}

{%- for post in site.posts -%}
  {%- assign bucket = "other" -%}
  {%- if post.tags contains "luxury-watches" -%}
    {%- assign bucket = "watch" -%}
  {%- elsif post.tags contains "luxury-handbags" -%}
    {%- assign bucket = "bag" -%}
  {%- else -%}
    {%- for t in post.tags -%}
      {%- assign tk = t | downcase | strip -%}
      {%- if dev_tags contains tk -%}
        {%- assign bucket = "dev" -%}
      {%- endif -%}
    {%- endfor -%}
  {%- endif -%}

  {%- assign desc = post.description | default: post.excerpt | strip_html | normalize_whitespace | strip | truncate: 200 -%}
  {%- capture line -%}
    - [{{ post.title | strip }}]({{ post.url | absolute_url }}){% if desc != "" %}: {{ desc }}{% endif %}
  {%- endcapture -%}

  {%- if bucket == "dev" and n_dev < 15 -%}
    {%- assign dev_list = dev_list | append: line | append: nl -%}
    {%- assign n_dev = n_dev | plus: 1 -%}
  {%- elsif bucket == "watch" and n_watch < 12 -%}
    {%- assign watch_list = watch_list | append: line | append: nl -%}
    {%- assign n_watch = n_watch | plus: 1 -%}
  {%- elsif bucket == "bag" and n_bag < 10 -%}
    {%- assign bag_list = bag_list | append: line | append: nl -%}
    {%- assign n_bag = n_bag | plus: 1 -%}
  {%- elsif bucket == "other" and n_other < 10 -%}
    {%- assign other_list = other_list | append: line | append: nl -%}
    {%- assign n_other = n_other | plus: 1 -%}
  {%- endif -%}
{%- endfor -%}

{%- assign tool_list = "" -%}
{%- assign info_list = "" -%}
{%- for p in site.pages -%}
  {%- capture pline -%}
    - [{{ p.title | default: p.basename | capitalize }}]({{ p.url | absolute_url }}){% if p.description %}: {{ p.description | strip_newlines | strip }}{% endif %}
  {%- endcapture -%}
  {%- if tool_files contains p.path -%}
    {%- assign tool_list = tool_list | append: pline | append: nl -%}
  {%- elsif info_files contains p.path -%}
    {%- assign info_list = info_list | append: pline | append: nl -%}
  {%- endif -%}
{%- endfor -%}
